description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/shelf_project.xlsx. You're building 3 floating shelves (34" each), 6 support brackets (9" each), and 2 back mounting strips (32" each). Pine boards come in 8-foot (96") lengths, and each saw cut wastes 1/8" (kerf). Create a cutting plan that shows which pieces come from which board, calculates waste per board (including kerf losses), and determines the minimum number of boards needed. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
